summary: Two Denver-area climbers got off-route at ~13,800 ft near the Crestone Traverse; one suffered a fatal fall and the partner was stranded, then rescued by helicopter.
location: Near the Crestone Traverse, Sangre de Cristo Range
responding_agency: Custer County Search and Rescue (Technical Rope Rescue); DFPC Canon City Helitack; Saguache County Search and Rescue
notes: Surviving partner down-climbed to the victim but could not ascend or descend; called for help via Garmin inReach; both extracted by CCSAR rope team with helicopter support. MERGE (run 535): CCSAR Past Missions write-up of the 2022-08-03 Crestone Traverse fatal fall appended (resolves the long-standing "Crestone Peak Aug. 22" date pin from the Monte Vista Journal — MVJ date was an error; the 66-year-old Denver-area climber died on the Crestone Traverse 2022-08-03). Merged HOTR corroboration (run 716): same incident confirmed via parent-opened HOTR piece.
